## Scope
Describe application changes and removed files. GitHub is a manual mirror; merge does not deploy.

## Review checks
- [ ] Owner-approved public copy; claim/evidence boundaries preserved.
- [ ] No private Lovable/editorial records, credentials or confidential materials in the public diff.
- [ ] Binary assets and all required routes included.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_public_mirror.py` passed (path check only).
- [ ] Tests, lint and build passed on this PR.
- [ ] Sitemap, robots, canonicals and Journal noindex status checked.
- [ ] A separate Lovable deployment action is documented if requested.
- [ ] Rollback reference recorded.

## QA and limitations
Provide links to CI, manual checks and any unverified claims or third-party URLs.
